title: SignPort common definitions v1
description: Shared primitive types. Encoding rules: document hashes and certificate fingerprints are lowercase hexadecimal; cryptographic digests and raw signatures are standard Base64 (RFC 4648 section 4, padded); identifiers are lowercase canonical UUIDs. The host 'signport.invalid' in $id is a provisional, non-resolvable namespace (domain not yet decided).

Uuid.description: Canonical lowercase UUID (versions 1-8; UUIDv7 recommended for generated IDs).

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with 'Z' suffix.

UnixTime.description: Seconds since the Unix epoch (JWT NumericDate, integer only).

Sha256Hex.description: SHA-256 value as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Used for document hashes (audit) and certificate fingerprints. Never the input of a signature operation.

Sha256Base64.description: SHA-256 digest, standard padded Base64, exactly 32 bytes when decoded (44 characters, canonical final character).

DerBase64.description: DER-encoded ASN.1 SEQUENCE (first byte 0x30, therefore first Base64 character 'M'), standard padded Base64. Schema-level check only; parsing happens in Engine/Hub.

CertificateChain.description: Intermediate and root certificates as offered by the provider; auxiliary only, trust is decided server-side against the trust bundle.

RsaSignatureBase64.description: Raw RSA signature bytes (no CMS wrapping), standard Base64. Length range covers 2048 to 4096-bit moduli; exact length must equal the modulus length and is checked by the verifier.

SignatureAlgorithm.description: RSA_PKCS1_V1_5 = RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 over a precomputed digest (SignHash semantics; DigestInfo built once by the signer API).

PolicyId.description: Signature policy identifier. 'icpbr-pades-rb' = ICP-Brasil PAdES AD-RB; exact OIDs and DOC-ICP-15 version are PENDING the P1 PoC and must not be assumed.

HttpsOrigin.description: Exact web origin: https scheme, lowercase host, optional port; no path, query, fragment, userinfo, wildcard or trailing slash. 'localhost' is accepted by the pattern but only dev builds may trust it.

CompactJws.description: JWS Compact Serialization (RFC 7515). Sensitive single-use capability: never log it.

StorageRef.description: Opaque, server-authorized storage key (relative, lowercase segments). Never a URL, absolute path or user-supplied path; '..' segments are impossible by construction.
